topics.title: The grandmother and the grandfather's portrait

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how the author portrays his grandmother's appearance and inner beauty.
Interpret the similes and images used to describe the grandmother.
Recall how the grandmother and the author spent their days in the village.
Explain why the move to the city school changed their friendship.
Analyse how the grandmother accepted her loneliness after the author went to university.
Evaluate the grandmother's calm and unsentimental strength of character.

topics.title: Homecoming, death and the mourning sparrows

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the grandmother's unusual behaviour on the evening of the author's return.
Interpret the sparrows' silent mourning at the grandmother's death.

topics.title: Working with words and noticing form

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the different senses of 'tell' and 'take' as used in the text.
Identify words that describe a manner of walking.
Recognise the past perfect form used to recount the distant past.
Identify the three phases of time depicted in the poem's three stanzas.
Interpret the poem's treatment of loss, memory and the transience of human life.
